name: Receipt Card
description: A paper receipt that feeds out of a printer slot line by line, with dotted leaders, a barcode and a serrated edge.

props.name: lines
props.type: { label: ReactNode; value?: ReactNode; bold?: boolean; rule?: boolean }[]
props.description: The body of the receipt, top to bottom. A line with a value gets a dotted leader and a right-aligned figure in mono; bold sets it heavier, as for a total; rule draws a dashed rule above it.

props.name: title
props.description: The header, centred above the lines.

props.name: footer
props.description: A closing line under the barcode.

props.name: code
props.description: The number under the barcode. Twelve or thirteen digits are drawn as a real EAN-13 with its check digit; anything else as a plain bar pattern.

props.name: speed
props.description: Feed speed multiplier. The paper prints itself the first time it scrolls into view.

props.name: ref
props.description: print() tears off the receipt that is out and prints it again.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is 300px wide by default and a figure; give it an aria-label.
